title: video-edit job
description: <outdir>/job.json, written by the session after prep. Names the source recording and its prep outputs, so the review page can play the source and show its words. Every path is absolute.

source.description: The original recording (never the prep proxy).

transcript.description: transcript.json from prep: {words: [{text, start, end, speaker?}]}.

sentences.description: sentences.json from prep, beside transcript.json: [{start, end, text, speaker?}].

kind.description: reels: clips from a long recording (Clips and Speakers tabs apply). demo: a screencast (those two tabs do not).
